notes: Company scope = HSN's 'Home' department (assigned site https://www.hsn.com/shop/home/ho), same scope used by the prior Home-Decor pass for SR80, not all of hsn.com. DISCOVERY: checked main mega-nav (Departments/Featured/Top New Arrivals Stores panels on the Home department page and on the sitewide /shop/clearance/4525 page), the sitewide Clearance page's own 'Departments' facet (which exposes a per-department 'Home' filter), and the site's own search for 'best sellers' (query redirected straight to the homepage - HSN has no dedicated Best Sellers page/URL). HSN has no page literally named 'Bestsellers' or 'Best Sellers'. The closest genuine site-defined popularity-merchandising listing is 'Customer Picks' (HSN's own facet metadata tags it as attribute Name='popular filters', Value='customer picks'), which HSN exposes department-scoped, including a Home-department version. This maps to the brief's 'Customer Favorites' / 'Most Popular' target terms. Treated as the Bestsellers-equivalent PLP for this company; not flagged, since the site's own facet explicitly labels it a popularity/'popular filters' concept rather than an editorial curation. No further genuine children (e.g. 'Furniture Customer Picks') were found - only the single Home-department-scoped listing.
